description.value: Pita Pit is a Canadian fast-casual chain specializing in freshly assembled pita sandwiches, salads, and rice bowls built from a wide selection of proteins and vegetables. This Chilliwack franchise (unit K300) offers takeout and online ordering through Uber Eats, Skip the Dishes, and DoorDash. The build-your-own format and healthy ingredient focus make it a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley.
